Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one square storyboard review page for NIHON QUEST. Re-render scenes as a polished soft 3D animated-game miniature, NOT anime illustration.
STYLE AUTHORITY: reference image 1, the C06 child-and-apple storyboard. Match its rounded sculpted 3D bodies, solid dimensional faces, broad sculpted hair clumps, soft matte cloth, real contact shadows, warm morning sunlight, blue sky and gentle depth of field. Everything including background is fully rendered 3D. No ink contours, no painterly watercolor, no flat illustrated faces, no gritty photorealism, no glitter or ornate details.
Reference image 2 when provided is the five-person identity sheet: apple shopkeeper woman with dark low bun, rust shirt, cream apron, brown pants; child with black bob, mustard tie-neck tunic, brown shorts, low brown shoes; gray-haired gray-bearded craftsman navy shirt ochre apron; woman traveler sage green coat cream dress brown crossbody bag; man traveler rust jacket dark gray pants rolled brown backpack. Preserve these identities and attire. Do NOT copy the apple creature from the style reference into other scenes.
LAYOUT: square white page with five equally-sized wide 16:9 black-bordered scene frames arranged two columns and three rows, final bottom-right cell empty white. Read left to right then downward. Short page heading at top. Only panel IDs below their frames, on white margin. No arrows, captions, callouts or English words INSIDE the scenes. Exactly five images, not six. These are five moments in ONE continuous shot, preserve camera axis, lens, scale, world layout and prop identity. No cutting between wide and closeup. Make the changes in action unmistakable, while conserving all objects and people.
Image 3 is OLD staging only; its painted/anime style is rejected. Rebuild it entirely in the C06 3D rendering.
Heading exactly "V00 / C01 / 0-5s". Frame IDs B01 B02 B03 B04 B05.
A peaceful small timber-and-stone Japanese-inspired fantasy village morning. Fixed continuous street-wide view with only slight horizontal camera drift. Left foreground an apple stall with dull red cloth awning and low horizontal shop sign mounted below counter height at child's eye level. Beside it, an open-front carpenter's workshop and workbench, same street extending toward right. Hills and simple greenery background. Exactly five residents: shopkeeper behind left stall, craftsman at neighboring bench, two adult travelers in street on right, child near stall. All five visible or naturally occluded in the same spatial arrangement, no duplicates, no crowd. Before any magic; no erasure here.
B01: establish daily life, shopkeeper sorting apples, craftsman calmly planing, two travelers discussing their route, child approaching low sign.
B02: same wide framing, keeper gently puts an apple into her basket, other residents continue.
B03: same wide framing, sage-coated woman traveler points down the street and backpack man nods.
B04: same wide framing, travelers begin one small step down the same street while craftsman continues planing; child reaches shop sign.
B05: same wide framing, child looks at low shop sign while the adults continue their routines. The sign has the simple Japanese place name "あおもり", a temporary storyboard lettering cue. Keep sign on stall front, do not make child point at high awning.
Priority: warm rounded 3D cast and 3D village matching C06; legible everyday actions, not a panoramic painted village.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a square storyboard page, FIVE moments of one continuous fixed shot for NIHON QUEST.
Primary request: replace an unreadable flat map diagram with a concrete understandable 3D scene: knowledge connections and a sea route vanish, leaving towns unable to connect. No maps or technical diagrams.
Reference image1 C06 is STYLE ONLY: match warm morning sun, smooth matte miniature 3D, rounded simple timber buildings and trees, blue sea, gentle depth of field. Do not add child or apple character.
Layout square white page, heading "V00 / C07 / 32-38s". Five equally-sized 16:9 black-bordered panels, 2columns x3rows, bottom-right cell empty white. IDs BELOW frames on white: B31 B32 B33 B34 B35. No other words, no diagrams, no arrows.
ONE IDENTICAL FIXED elevated three-quarter 3D coastal diorama in every panel. Large foreground island on left with a small timber harbor village and wooden pier; a second small harbor settlement on right across a short narrow channel, another small cluster deeper inland on left. A winding real dirt road joins the two left settlements. A SINGLE small wooden passenger boat near left pier, bow pointing toward right shore. Shores, buildings, trees, real dirt road and piers stay completely intact at exactly same positions across all five. Frame close enough to read boat and villages, not a distant Japan map. No globe, no prefecture lines. This is a fictional miniature setting, not accurate named geography.
Story sequence:
B31: normal warm connected world. A clearly visible golden luminous trace follows the left dirt road and crosses the sea channel from left pier to right harbor, like a thin glowing ribbon laid onto the real road/water. One boat starts from left pier. No barriers.
B32: middle of the overland luminous ribbon develops a clear LARGE dark gap. Underlying dirt road still intact. Boat slightly further from left pier. Sea ribbon still intact.
B33: the golden ribbons fade out entirely along road AND sea. Roads, towns, water remain unchanged and unharmed. Boat near mid-channel, not at destination.
B34: a tall thin translucent pale-blue curved curtain across the channel becomes visible ahead of boat, boat halts safely just before it. NO crash, NO sinking. Barrier is clearly distinct from normal blue water and blocks travel, not a wave.
B35: same halted boat, same quiet translucent curtain across channel, no golden connections anywhere. Towns remain on same land, physically undamaged but disconnected. Hold.
The five images must have visibly different connectivity states without shrinking the scene or destroying terrain. Keep exact world layout and warm 3D art direction throughout. No fantasy castle, technology, monsters, villain, text overlay, flat graphics, English instructions or tiny map dots.

IDENTICAL fixed three-quarter overhead CLOSE view of a small ordinary OPEN travel notebook centered on a timber desk, red-brown plain soft cover, ONE brass button clasp at outer right edge, two cream paper pages. No gold ornament. A simple graphite pencil beside notebook at left, a single loose blank page at right, positions fixed. Same angle/scale/lighting in all four. Show enough of notebook for book object to read clearly; marks visibly lie FLAT on paper.
B36: both notebook pages visibly contain handwritten simple notes and sketches: on left one small pencil apple drawing and below it readable Japanese "りんご 3こ"; on right one simple hill/river route sketch and the short word "かわ". Gray graphite, all flat.
B37: exact SAME markings at exact same positions become pale and partially erased; apple outline and words recognizably thinning; physical book remains solid.
B38: almost all marks gone, only a faint part of apple outline and a few pale pencil strokes remain, no new writing.
B39: BOTH pages fully BLANK cream paper, same notebook and desk unchanged. Hold on erased record.
CRITICAL: no paper fragments, no floating letters, no shards, no chess pieces, no flying objects, no glows, no magical rays, no ink entering book, no mysterious hand/villain, no people. Text on early panel is storyboard cue only. Disappearance happens IN PLACE, on paper, and never reverses. This is a plain travel NOTEBOOK, not a lore object requiring explanation.

ONE CRITICAL CORRECTION: B32 (top-right frame) currently has an explosion-like black crater/cloud on the dirt road. REMOVE the entire black cloud, black hole, sparks, smoke and any damage. Restore a complete normal continuous tan dirt road and normal grass/fence exactly like B31 in that spot. The ONLY change from B31 to B32 should be that a short middle segment of the GOLDEN GLOWING LINE is no longer glowing. It is a GAP IN LIGHT laid over an INTACT normal road, not a physical gap in land. Keep gold line before and after the gap and across the sea in B32. No dark particles, no black smoke, no explosion, no scorched ground, no portal.
SECOND SMALL CORRECTION: B35 (bottom-left) is a held pose of B34 (middle-right), so keep the stopped boat and pale-blue sea curtain at the SAME world positions and scale as B34, with no boat traveling backwards and no curtain shifting closer. Towns and intact road remain unchanged.
All other frames B31/B33/B34 should be preserved. No arrows or captions. Output the full edited square storyboard page, not one crop.
